summary: Iter 216h70 — Brand Auto-Discovery feature testing complete. All backend API tests (7/7) and frontend UI tests passed. Verified: (1) POST /start returns {ok:true, status:'queued'}, (2) GET /status transitions queued→running→ready within ~10s, (3) Ready draft contains colours, fonts, logos, images, socials, intelligence, pages_visited, (4) POST /apply copies draft values to brand-kit and flips status to 'applied', (5) POST /discard wipes the doc, (6) POST /apply without ready draft returns 400, (7) Endpoints require marketing module (auth guard). Frontend verified: Start tab is FIRST, Dashboard tab is SECOND (id=performance, label='Dashboard'), BrandDiscoveryPanel renders at top of Brand Kit tab with URL input and 'Discover my brand' button, running/ready/applied states work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Brand discovery backend implementation is solid - uses BackgroundTask for async crawl, PIL for image compression (quality=85, max 2000px), Claude Haiku 4.5 for intelligence extraction
Image storage uses put_object() which returns stored_url - verified to be GymAxis storage path (not customer CDN)
Frontend BrandDiscoveryPanel correctly polls /status every 2s while running, stops when ready/applied/failed
Tab order in MarketingSuite.js TABS array correctly places 'start' first and 'performance' (labelled 'Dashboard') second
Module guard (require_module('marketing')) correctly protects all 4 endpoints
seed_data_creation: None - used existing test user with marketing module enabled
